info.name: Madare Emrooz API
info.description:
Generate the Postman collection and environment in docs/postman/.

Run from the backend directory after adding or changing an endpoint:

    python scripts/generate_postman.py

tests/test_postman.py fails when a route is missing from ENDPOINTS or the JSON files are stale.

Using it: import both files into Postman and pick the "Madare Emrooz (local)" environment. Its
baseUrl is the docker compose stack (http://localhost:8080); for `flask run` set it to
http://localhost:5000.
Run "Request code" then "Sign in" in "Auth (mother)" or "Auth (staff)"; the sign-in saves the
token for that folder. With SMS_BACKEND=console the code is printed in the server log.
Requests that create something (a pregnancy link, a staff member, a document…) save its id for
the requests that follow. The folders are in an order that works with "Run collection".

request.description: Sends a 6-digit code by SMS (202). Any format works: 0912…, +98 912…, Persian digits. Limits: 1 per minute and 5 per hour per number, 20 per hour per network (429 + Retry-After). Simultaneous requests are handled one at a time, so they can't get past the limits.

Returns a 15-minute access token, a 30-day refresh token and is_new_user. A new number creates a mother's account. Put the SMS code in the otpCode variable first. The code expires after 2 minutes, works once and locks after 5 wrong tries, also under parallel requests.
The old refresh token stops working.
204; this device's session ends.
The signed-in account: id, mobile, role.
200 when the API can reach its database, 503 otherwise. For load balancers.

item.description: Staff (midwife, doctor, admin) sign in the same way. Their account must first be created by an admin (or `flask create-admin` for the first admin).

item.name: Mother · onboarding
item.description: Profile and medical history. GET /profile → 404 means a new user.

request.description: `home` says which screen to open: pregnancy, trying_to_conceive, postpartum, fitness or rehabilitation.

201 when created, 200 when updated. join_goal: pregnancy | fitness | rehabilitation; reproductive_status (pregnancy path): trying_to_conceive | pregnant | postpartum. An Rh-negative mother gets the needs_rhogam risk tag unless spouse_blood_type is known to be Rh-negative; leave it out when unknown. birth_date must be before today (Tehran).
Every field is optional; null means not answered.

exec: const items = pm.response.json().items; if (items && items.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('midwifeId', items[0].id); }
const items = pm.response.json().items; if (items && items.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('documentId', items[0].id); }

request.description: dashboard_unlocked is false until staff record the specialist visit.
is_advanced_locked stays true until the visit and a doctor's approval.

Only the chosen sub-type's questions may be answered. Changing the answers after a doctor's approval withdraws that approval: is_advanced_locked turns true again until a doctor approves the new answers. The recorded visit is kept.

item.name: Mother · pregnancy
item.description: Pregnancy, bleeding reports, partner QR code.

request.description: The due date is calculated from the LMP. Only one active pregnancy (409). lmp_date may not be after today in Tehran, nor more than 44 weeks ago.
Week and due date, counted on Tehran's date; gestational_week is never below 0. due_date_source is lmp or clinician.
Send only the fields to fix: lmp_date, avg_cycle_length_days, conception_type, care_provider_type, care_provider_name. A clinician-set due date is kept.
Only during a pregnancy. true raises a red alert for her midwife (or the admins).
Returns url (encode it in the QR code) and token. A new link replaces the old one.
What the spouse sees after scanning: Persian page with the week and Jalali due date.
